title: Field Service Engineer - Slot Machines
description:
Field Service Engineer - Slot Machines

Location: Regional Field-Based Role (travel required)

Contract: Full Time, Permanent

Salary: £31,019.58 per annum plus £2,600 on call allowance

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced engineer who enjoys problem solving, working independently, and delivering excellent service. You'll play a vital role in ensuring our customers enjoy a seamless gaming experience by maintaining, repairing, installing, and supporting our slot machine estate and associated IT equipment.

Hit the Jackpot with Our Benefits

In return for everything you bring, we offer an exciting role in a dynamic business and a great rewards package. We’ll help you build your skills and career as you work with us in a business that never stands still. That means you’ll have access to:

  • Help@Hand – a physical and mental wellbeing app for you and your family giving you fast remote access to a GP for advice and more
  • Thrive App – for your mental wellbeing approved by the NHS
  • Buzz Brights Apprenticeships
  • Buzz Brilliance Awards – Employee Recognition Scheme
  • Buzz Learning, our digital learning platform with access to 100s of online courses
  • Access to Trained Mental Health Advocates for advice on your mental wellbeing
  • 5 weeks Annual Leave plus Public Holidays
  • Buy Holidays Salary Sacrifice Scheme – opportunity to buy an extra week’s holiday
  • Staff discount 50% off bingo tickets, food & soft drink

What You'll Be Doing

  • Installing, configuring and commissioning slot machines and IT hardware in line with manufacturer and regulatory requirements.
  • Carrying out internal machine movements and relocations within clubs.
  • Performing planned preventative maintenance to maximise machine uptime and reliability.
  • Diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, electrical and mechanical faults.
  • Responding to service incidents and providing technical support to club colleagues.
  • Maintaining accurate service records, maintenance logs and inventory documentation.
  • Ensuring all work is completed in line with gaming regulations, company policies and health & safety requirements.
  • Building strong working relationships with club teams, regional management and support functions.
  • Collaborating with IT Support, Central Engineering and the Service Desk to resolve complex issues.
  • Staying up to date with the latest slot machine and IT technologies and best practices.

What We're Looking For

  • Previous experience in a field service, engineering, gaming, arcade, amusement, casino or related technical role.
  • Strong knowledge of IT hardware and electronic gaming machine maintenance and repair.
  • Experience diagnosing and resolving complex hardware, software, mechanical and electrical issues.
  • Excellent communication skills and a customer-first approach.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • An understanding of gaming regulations and compliance requirements (desirable).
  • The flexibility to work occasional evenings, weekends and bank holidays when required.
  • A willingness to participate in a paid out-of-hours and weekend on-call rota.
  • A full UK driving licence with no more than 3 penalty points.
  • The ability to travel extensively within your region, including occasional overnight stays.

Ready to Power Up Your Career?

If you're ready to bring your technical skills, customer focus, and energy to a role where no two days are the same, apply now and join a team that keeps the fun running!
